receipt_commit_note: This regenerated receipt is committed separately after the tested fix commit; its own SHA is available in git log.
shared_hook: v2v_runtime.controller_class explicitly opts in only when an intent-enabled wrapper supplies callable publish_trigger_intent. A separate trigger_intent_board produces trigger_v2v and published_trigger_intent records after unchanged base action/publication operations. Ordinary V2V/intent policies retain their existing sampled payloads and outputs. The prior explicit intent_base_policy discovery hook is retained.

blockers_fixed.issue: Globally conditioned base IntentPolicy publications indirectly reached the trigger through partner-intent inputs
blockers_fixed.fix: Keep the base intent board/publication separate. Generate trigger-facing intents using each reporting CAV's own sensor row, range-filtered V2V block and previously published local-only trigger intents, with a constant zero broadcast latent. Store this independent trigger_v2v in the sample context. Trigger distribution, value, PPO evaluation and imitation require and consume that recorded block, including for pre-widened x; they never fall back to base intents. Missing/incomplete local payloads refuse. Both frozen and fine-tuned modes use this path.
blockers_fixed.regression: Actual controller at ticks 301, 302, 303 and 305 with nonzero broadcast, intent-head and receiving-column weights. Changing only HDV speed at 0 m from 5 to 25, outside ego/peer sensing at -400/-380 m, changes RSU and received base intents but leaves trigger blocks, logits, values, sampled actions/logp and subsequent PPO update metrics/parameters exactly equal. Independent peer-only local HDV perturbation outside ego sensing changes the reporting peer's local publication and the ego trigger; replacing only that local partner report restores exact ego logits/value. Both modes covered. Replay also ignores corrupted base V2V and appended widened intent columns, supports no rsu, preserves snapshots, and refuses missing local payloads for PPO and CE. Existing deterministic/stochastic actual-controller tests retain exact low-level requests, action/noise/logp/value fields, generator state and base publication/board parity, excluding only the new trigger metadata. First-tick and skipped-tick local intent invalidation are covered.

api.construction: TriggerPolicy(loaded_v2v_policy, v2v_dim=48, n_candidates=<registered budget>, partner_slots=5, freeze_base=True, moves_api=None). Also supports V2V-only width 24; width must match actor. moves_api=None lazily imports tools.coopmwm.moves. CPU only; attachment preserves global torch RNG.
api.base_policy: forward(context), sample(...), score(sample) delegate unchanged. Frozen trigger updates preserve all base tensors and sampled actions/noise. Low-level MAPPO continues using its existing inputs and base intent publications independently.
api.trigger_features: Per-member 29-wide sensor row, configured V2V block, constant four-wide zero latent, loaded per-CAV actor trunk, candidate descriptors. Intent-enabled actors require context.trigger_v2v, even if x is already widened. The raw context.v2v and any appended base intent columns are ignored by the trigger. No RSU, broadcast or pooled critic input. Caller-supplied sensor rows, candidate states, identities and non-intent V2V fields must have causal local observable provenance.
api.intent_adapter: intent_base_policy() -> base_policy retains discovery. publish_trigger_intent(context) -> {CAV id: clipped H-wide local-only planned commands} uses the loaded intent head on the zero-broadcast local trunk. controller_class(Controller) supports TriggerPolicy(IntentPolicy(...)) directly; maintains separate base and trigger boards, each visible only at t-1, with first/missing/stale publications invalid. Sample context records trigger_v2v; sample records published_trigger_intent. Base publication remains sample.published_intent.
api.decide: decide(context, obs_states={ego: local_observable_state}, observable_cavs={ego: ordered_local_CAV_ids_including_ego}, rng=numpy_rng, generator=torch_cpu_generator, deterministic=False) -> TriggerBatch. Caller owns registered cadence; candidates drawn once per ego.
api.discrete_actions: 0=none; 1..N=family/partners/parameter candidate bucket. Family one-hot, observable partner membership and onset/hold/depth normalized using VARIETY_REGISTERED; unavailable slots masked.
api.move_contract: moves.FAMILIES includes none; candidates(obs_state, rng, n) returns objects/mappings with family, members, onset_s, hold_s, depth; offsets(move, elapsed_s) returns member acceleration offsets. Non-none moves require 1..4 unique observable CAV members including ego and registered parameter ranges.
api.rollout: TriggerBatch deep-copies context including local trigger_v2v, tables, descriptors/mask, actions and detached old logp/values. selected() -> {ego: Move_or_None}; evaluate(batch) -> per-CAV logp, value, entropy. PPO replay uses recorded local messages and never draws new candidates or refreshes old intents from a live board/current publisher.
api.optimizer: optimizer(lr=...) owns exactly learning_parameters(). Frozen: trigger score/value heads only. freeze_base=False: also actor parameters, never broadcast/critic/intent_head/log_std. Local trigger publication is no-grad; it changes no optimizer ownership. Old globally conditioned intent-enabled trigger rollouts must be recollected under the corrected local-only path; they are refused if trigger_v2v is absent. Pre-r1 optimizer states containing broadcast parameters still require rebuilding.
api.ppo_update: ppo_update(policy, optimizer, batch, advantages, returns, clip_ratio=..., value_weight=..., entropy_weight=..., max_grad_norm=...) -> loss, policy_loss, value_loss, entropy, approx_kl, clip_fraction, grad_norm, cav_count. One clipped minibatch step; caller owns GAE/epochs/KL budget. No silent advantage normalization.
api.imitation: imitation_loss(batch, target_action_indices) -> masked-table cross entropy using the same local-only recorded input path; targets index the recorded table.
api.checkpoint: Standard state_dict/load_state_dict(strict=True), optimizer state_dict and CPU generator state. No new learned parameters. Reconstruct identical constructor settings, family ordering and variety registration. Runtime continuation must retain/replay both timestamped boards separately; never seed the trigger board from base publications.
api.execution_start: MoveExecutor(moves_api=None).start(move, ego=..., observable_cav_ids=..., now=..., until=...) -> bool. Explicit commitment expiry; none abstains; overlapping member sets rejected atomically.
api.execution_requests: requests(base_actions, native_commands, now=..., eligible_cav_ids=..., feasible_bounds=...) -> overlay with requested_raw and acceleration_residual. Offsets compose on absolute MAPPO actions, clamp to observable feasibility bounds and the 1.2 m/s^2 CAV cap. No HDV/departed/ineligible command; unaffected requests unchanged.
api.integration: Merge overlay before existing feasibility/CommandOwnership single-writer routing and retain speedMode 27. T2C supplies causal local states, identities, cadence, bounds, eligibility and expiry; use the supported controller or generate/record an equivalent independent local-only trigger_v2v path for bank/dense-label contexts. No TraCI calls, horizon changes or B/R-specific behavior.
